name: simplysim-esim-finder
description: Find and compare SimplySIM travel data eSIM plans for 180+ countries and check phone eSIM compatibility.

interface.longDescription:
SimplySIM eSIM Finder helps travellers choose a data-only eSIM for a trip. Ask about a country or region and it lists SimplySIM plans with data allowance, validity, price, networks and coverage, so you can compare single-country, regional (for example Europe) and global options side by side. It can also check whether a phone model supports eSIM, including any caveats such as region-specific models.

Intended for travellers planning mobile data abroad. Each plan comes with a link to its page on simplysim.co.uk, where you can read the full details.

Limitations: plans are data-only (no calls or SMS). The compatibility check uses SimplySIM's device list, so a phone that is not listed should be checked in the phone's own settings for an eSIM option. Prices are shown in GBP or EUR and can change; the plan page on simplysim.co.uk shows the current price.
defaultPrompt: Which eSIM plans cover Spain for a week?
Compare Europe eSIM plans with at least 10GB for 30 days.
Does my iPhone 15 Pro support eSIM?

positive.description: Find plans for a single country
positive.prompt: Which eSIM plans cover Spain for a week?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Spain, then lists Spain and regional Europe plans with at least 7 days validity, showing data, days, price in GBP and networks, each with its simplysim.co.uk plan link.

positive.prompt: Compare Europe eSIM plans with at least 10GB for 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Europe regional plans of 10GB or more with 30 or more days validity, compared by price, data, coverage count and networks.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the Spain 1GB 7 day plan, which networks and countries does it cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Spain 1GB 7Days plan with its networks, speed, coverage and validity, and the plan's page link on simplysim.co.uk.

positive.prompt: Does my iPhone 15 Pro support eSIM?
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms Apple iPhone 15 Pro is on the compatibility list and passes on the caveat that some models sold in mainland China, Hong Kong and Macao may not support eSIM.

positive.prompt: Is there an unlimited data eSIM for Japan?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Japan and lists the unlimited plans with validity, price and any daily high-speed allowance, plus the plan links.

negative.description: Purchase request: the plugin cannot take payment and should point to the plan page instead
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest Spain eSIM for me and charge my card.

negative.description: Destination that does not exist: report no match rather than inventing plans
negative.prompt: Find me an eSIM for Atlantis.

negative.description: Unrelated request outside the plugin's scope
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Madrid.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It provides plan information and phone compatibility checks, with links to plan information pages on simplysim.co.uk.

publication.release_notes: First release: search destinations, compare eSIM plans, view plan details and check phone eSIM compatibility.
